profile.title: Advocate · Assistant Professor of Law

about: Assistant Professor at United University, Prayagraj — Uttar Pradesh. Advocate at the Patna High Court and member of the District Bar Association, Aurangabad (Bihar). UGC-NET qualified legal educator with academic interests spanning constitutional law, jurisprudence, and criminal law.
